Our smart home product community has been very active lately — YouTube comments, DMs, and FAQ threads are piling up and nobody on the content team has time to read through all of it. I've exported everything from October 2024 into a file at `workspace/community_data/raw_exports/comments_oct2024.json`.

I need you to go through all of those messages, make sense of what our audience is actually asking about, and turn it into a structured content backlog we can hand off to the video production team. There's a lot of noise and repetition in there, so please clean it up properly before drawing any conclusions.

The output should be saved as `content_backlog.json`. It needs to include everything the production team needs to start scripting — the grouped topic areas, how they were ranked and why, the actual content angles, and a section on what we should do next with the community itself.
